chilli.name: Chilli
chilli.season_note: Typical windows overlap April/early May and late October/mid-November; controlled conditions may permit year-round cultivation. Months are approximate, not exclusion rules.
evidence_notes: Climate and soil sections support temperature, elevation and drainage screening. Annual rainfed rainfall guidance cannot be compared with monthly rainfall.

okra.name: Okra
okra.season_note: Typical windows overlap early April/early May and early September/early October. Months are approximate; local confirmation is required.
evidence_notes: Climate section excludes the upcountry wet zone. Soil section requires drainage but supplies no numerical pH bounds.

brinjal.name: Brinjal
brinjal.season_note: Planting-month guidance is unknown in this catalog.
evidence_notes: Climate and soil sections verified through DOA indexed page text after direct fetch timeouts.

tomato.name: Tomato
tomato.season_note: Source nursery dates are not encoded as field planting months.
evidence_notes: Temperature and pH are optimum ranges used for conservative shortlist screening, not absolute survival limits. Source optimum elevation of 1000-2000 m is not a cultivation cutoff; introduction permits most zones except upcountry wet. Land preparation calls for drains to prevent retention.

cabbage.name: Cabbage
cabbage.season_note: Planting-month guidance is unknown in this catalog.
evidence_notes: Best pH range is used for conservative screening. Cool climate is qualitative; heat-tolerant varieties may suit the dry zone. No temperature cutoff is inferred.

carrot.name: Carrot
carrot.season_note: Planting-month guidance is unknown in this catalog.
evidence_notes: Source describes cool upcountry conditions and cultivation in all zones, without numerical screening bounds. Drainage alone is insufficient to establish a farm-specific environmental fit.

pumpkin.name: Pumpkin
pumpkin.season_note: Source describes Yala pumpkin cultivation; zone-dependent seasons are not converted to universal months.
evidence_notes: The source's 500 m elevation guidance applies to dry and intermediate zones; these zones are not supplied by this request, so no universal elevation cutoff is encoded. Confirm the zone locally. Irrigation section requires drains and avoiding submerged vines.

bitter_gourd.name: Bitter Gourd
bitter_gourd.season_note: Typical Yala months April/May and Maha months October/November; suitable areas may permit year-round cultivation.
evidence_notes: Soil section supplies pH and drainage. Elevation wording is ambiguous and is deliberately not encoded as a maximum.

luffa.name: Luffa
luffa.season_note: Wet-zone cultivation may be year-round; dry-zone Yala requires irrigation. No universal month rule is encoded.
evidence_notes: Climate and soil sections support elevation, pH and drainage. Hot weather is qualitative and has no numerical cutoff.

snake_gourd.name: Snake Gourd
snake_gourd.season_note: Source describes dry-zone Yala and wet-zone year-round cultivation. No universal month rule is encoded.
evidence_notes: Climate and soil sections support elevation, pH and drainage. High temperature preference has no numerical bounds.
